ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels and 60% low-intensity black/dark-green pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation originates from the median notch and spreads along the trailing edges to the distal tips, creating a 'V' or 'butterfly' shape. White pigmentation is concentrated on the proximal-lateral regions of both lobes, with significant dark mottling and spotting on the white surface of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency and high-amplitude jaggedness; the trailing edge is defined by irregular peaks and deep valleys (serrations) across the entire boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong upward convex curve toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) are scattered across the high-intensity white regions of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, roughly parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the lower-left white section of the fluke, oriented horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant horizontal rake marks on the left lobe; highly irregular and potentially damaged trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: The dark central pigmentation pattern is highly symmetrical and tapers sharply towards the center of each lobe.
